Protocol amended to v1.1 before any screening decision: the blind dual-screen sample is 20% of each batch, minimum 50 and now capped at 150 records. Rationale: the first database run (IEEE Xplore, pillar 1) returned 3,759 records; 150 blind records give a kappa estimate with a confidence interval of roughly plus or minus 0.12, which is sufficient to apply the kappa 0.6 suspension rule, while 752 would make the AI-assistance policy more expensive than screening by hand. Sample drawn with a fixed seed as a prefix of the original 20% draw.
